title: RetroRapid!
subtitle: Retro lanes. Live friend races. One more run.
description:
RetroRapid! brings back the charm of classic LCD handhelds from the late '80s and early '90s. Steer left or right, dodge traffic, and chase a high score as the road gets faster. Every overtake counts, and you have three lives to make them count.

Play solo, or race a friend live with SharePlay on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. You face the same traffic, follow each other's score and lives, and can jump straight into a rematch. Friend races are always free and never use your daily solo plays.
nameOrigin: Unexpectedly released with love ❤️ from the ARCtic conference in Oulu, Finland. Thanks to everyone that played the game and encouraged me to push the button.

features.title: The look you grew up with
features.description: RetroRapid! channels classic LCD handhelds with a clean, native implementation. Unlimited Plays unlocks the additional visual Styles available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac, while every currently available Style is free on Apple Watch.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on iPad using the green Pocket visual theme, with pixel cars on a three-lane road and large red controls at each side.

features.title: Made for Every Apple Screen
features.description: Play on Apple Watch, iPhone, iPad, or Mac with an interface and controls tailored to each device. Apple Watch play has no daily limit, and iPhone Duo adds a tabletop layout with the road above the fold and controls below.
features.imageDescription: A person playing RetroRapid! on Apple Watch beside the water, with the watch and racing screen centered in the photo.

features.title: Race Friends Live
features.description: Start a live two-player SharePlay race on iPhone, iPad, or Mac, then jump into a rematch. Game Center adds leaderboards, achievements, and friends' best-score markers to every solo score chase.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on Mac showing an achievement sheet over the racing screen for completing a run with VoiceOver controls.

features.title: VoiceOver, Cues, and Haptics
features.description: RetroRapid! supports VoiceOver and Direct Touch, pairing spoken feedback with configurable audio cues and haptics. Pause to hear the road layout, and choose how speed changes are announced.
features.imageDescription: A close-up of RetroRapid! settings on iPhone showing speed-increase warning feedback, a preview warning, Detailed Road, Big Cars, and Direct Touch.

features.title: Play your way
features.description: Race with taps, swipes, keyboard arrows, the Digital Crown, or a supported MFi, Xbox, or PlayStation controller. Remap controller actions and tune sound, haptics, fonts, and road options.
features.imageDescription: RetroRapid! on Mac with the Settings window open over the racing screen, showing font, speed, audio feedback, volume, control help, and accessibility options.

features.title: Adaptive Interface by Default
features.description: RetroRapid! supports Larger Text, Dark Interface, sufficient contrast, Reduce Motion, and portrait or landscape play. Big Cars makes the traffic easier to see without changing the challenge.
features.imageDescription: A hand holding an iPhone in portrait orientation running RetroRapid!, showing the retro-styled Score display and pixelated car sprites in a real-world setting

whySection: RetroRapid! is built around nostalgia, accessibility, and native Apple-platform craft. Solo play includes 9 runs on your first day and 3 each day after that on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. SharePlay friend races and Apple Watch play are always free. Unlimited Plays is one optional purchase for unlimited solo runs and the additional visual Styles available on those platforms. It is eligible for Family Sharing, never a subscription, and priced by region with local purchasing power in mind. There are no developer-operated analytics, ads, or tracking.
supportText: Need help with RetroRapid! or want to share feedback? We're here to help you enjoy the retro racing experience!
